meta.purpose: Codex round 11P's [medium] #4 — make the mutation applier and its matrix reviewable rather than prose-only. M4, M7 and M8 are wave 14's, re-run through the committed applier so their earlier results are reproducible; M1 is wave 14's too and is re-run because it guards the same number the new below-target arm reports; M10 is round 11P's [medium] #3 requirement; M11 and M12 attack this wave's own retention-scoping text.
meta.not_mutation_testable: Round 11P's [medium] #1 (the offered-floor claim at poller.go floorOutcome/verifyFloor, plus the swept sites) is COMMENT text. There is no mutation of a comment a test can fail on, so it carries no row here and must not be reported as covered. What is testable about that finding is the WARN composition, which M1 and M10 attack.
meta.test_env: TEST_DATABASE_URL must be exported for internal/store; both packages are run whole so a kill is attributed to the tests that actually failed, not to a -run filter chosen to make one fail.
